workingTreeReview: Includes external-source creation/generation, the compile execution fix and per-release flat declaration formats. Catalog-derived tool lists were refreshed after the successful final Build-Release and Build-MultiVersion -Test.
scope: Functional review of selected engineering workflows and major version migration families; not an exhaustive API completeness claim.

implementationMeaning.implemented: An advertised implementation exists for the explicitly described scope; this is not native acceptance.
implementationMeaning.partial: Some stages or operations exist, but a declared workflow gap, runtime block or version-format limitation remains.
implementationMeaning.pending: The inspected API exists, but a dedicated advertised MCP implementation is missing for this scope.
implementationMeaning.unavailable: The exact inspected native API is absent from the supplied release SDK; this says nothing about manual TIA product features.
implementationMeaning.unverified: Equivalent API/service availability or semantics has not been established; absence of an XML match is not enough to generalize.

nativeAcceptance: NOT RUN for this eight-release feature review
evidenceLimits: SDK identifiers show static availability, not licenses, project capability or successful execution.
Advertised tool names come from manifest/version-tools.json; a route may still have an execution gate.
Broad family rows are deliberately partial on full engines until their subfeatures are reviewed.
Pending names in the historical PLC migration ledger are a subset, not an API gap count.
metadataReview: ReflectionOnlyLoadFrom of the original Siemens.Engineering.dll for V14 SP1, V15.1, V16, V17 and V18 confirmed the exact absent types/properties/import method underlying every unavailable cell. No TIA instance or native engineering call was executed.

features.title: Ordinary PLC block, type and tag-table browsing
features.scope: Advertised root/user PLC block/type readers; tag-table names are narrower on foundation hosts. System groups and units are separate scopes.
features.nextStep: Use these readers to verify generated/imported identities in each version test project.

features.title: PLC block/type/tag-table XML exchange
features.scope: Routes exist. V14 SP1 SCL XML is interface-only; cross-version schema/import compatibility and special block types are not established.
features.nextStep: Roundtrip a version-native fixture and compare blocks, types and tags; do not rewrite XML version markers.

features.title: Create an external source from a local file
features.scope: Foundation ImportPlcExternalSource now executes CreateFromFile(name, fullPath) for one ASCII SCL/AWL/DB/UDT root source, then reads back the actual source name. Preview/exact project/plan hash required; the older planning-only tool remains compatible.
features.nextStep: Run native source creation/readback on each selected test project. Chinese and other non-ASCII source encodings remain outside the foundation contract until version-specific validation.

features.title: Generate blocks from an external source
features.scope: Foundation generation is now exposed for exact root source names. V15.1+ calls GenerateBlocksFromSource(GenerateBlockOption.None) and records native returned objects. V14 SP1 uses the void overload: GeneratedObjects is empty and before/after inventories are observations, not a complete generated-object list. Existing blocks/types may be overwritten.
features.nextStep: Test generation followed by explicit compilation/readback. Preview reviews source identity and block/type metadata, not source contents. A normal native EngineeringException returns failed and retains the session; interruption or post-generation readback uncertainty requires reset. Generation does not compile/save/download.

features.title: Compile PLC software and read nested diagnostics
features.scope: The blanket foundation execution block has been removed. The selected PLC and all observed OnlineProvider/RH states must be Offline; missing required PLC providers and unknown/online observed states are refused. Devices/non-PLC software without exposed state are returned in OfflineStateNotExposedByDevices / meta.offlineStateNotExposedByDevices, not inferred Offline or refused solely for provider absence. Diagnostics use typed fields and recursive Messages.
features.nextStep: Compile valid/invalid sources on each release and compare native counts/diagnostics. Siemens still requires all devices Offline; independently confirm devices whose state is not exposed. No native acceptance is claimed.

features.title: Source creation, generation, compilation and readback
features.scope: Foundation source creation/generation now exist, with root/ASCII scope and V14 SP1 generation observations. Compilation checks observed states and reports unexposed device states for caller confirmation. Clients must check every stage. PlcBuildAndImport is a separate JSON-to-XML workflow, not external-source generation.
features.nextStep: Complete and test individual stages first; compose existing operations instead of implementing a second native pipeline.

features.title: Offline PLC XML builders for the selected release
features.scope: BuildPlcUdtXml and BuildPlcGlobalDbXml now construct explicit output for all eight releases using their interface schema versions and object attributes. The six other PLC builders remain V21-only candidates. I for V21 describes output format only.
features.nextStep: Complete target-specific formats for tag tables and executable blocks; whole-document/native import/CPU semantics remain unverified even when the interface fragment passes its XSD.

functionalEvidence.scope: Flat UDT/GlobalDB interface fragments against the real supplied XSD for each release; whole-document and native import validation NOT RUN.

features.title: Read ordinary technology-object metadata
features.scope: Foundation readers inspect the root through V18 and recurse through user groups from V19. This does not read live process values.
features.nextStep: Use exact identities to check technology-object imports.

features.title: Import technology-object XML
features.scope: The exact collection import API is absent from supplied V14 SP1/V15.1 XML; it exists from V16. MCP foundation import routes are absent at the review baseline.
features.nextStep: Implement V16-V18 root import and V19 group-aware import; reuse single-item execution for directory batches.

features.title: Technology-object user-group traversal
features.scope: The exact Groups property is present only in supplied V19-V21 SDKs. Root technology objects remain a separate supported scope.
features.nextStep: Preserve the version boundary when importing, exporting or resolving object paths.

features.title: Export technology-object XML
features.scope: Export API exists in all supplied releases, but foundation catalog excludes V14 SP1/V15.1 while their export semantics remain unreviewed.
features.nextStep: Review old-release export semantics and test root-object roundtrip independently of the unavailable collection import API.

features.title: Watch-table listing and XML exchange
features.scope: V15.1 adds listing; V16-V19 also expose export. Foundation import is missing although its SDK member exists from V15.1.
features.nextStep: Add offline XML import using the per-release collection API; leave online watch/force behavior as a separate feature.

features.title: Hardware catalog search
features.scope: The inspected catalog type begins in V18; its MCP route is admitted from V19. The V18 operation contract remains to be reviewed.
features.nextStep: Compare V18 search/provider signatures with V19 and expose only the supported search contract.

features.title: Create a device with its initial item
features.scope: Native CreateWithItem exists in every supplied SDK; foundation exposure currently starts at V19. Device/catalog-specific compatibility still requires a target.
features.nextStep: Separate the common exact-identifier creation API from newer catalog-search helpers before porting older releases.

features.title: Network interface and connection engineering
features.scope: An interface API exists in every SDK; foundation hosts have no dedicated network engineering routes. Full-engine action/version breadth is not fully audited here.
features.nextStep: Split interface addressing, subnets, IO systems, domains and communication connections into exact API-supported subfeatures.

features.title: CAx device exchange
features.scope: CAx provider exists in every supplied SDK; foundation hosts do not expose the full engine AML import route.
features.nextStep: Port provider-backed device exchange and verify import log plus actual device identities.

features.title: Project/global library engineering
features.scope: Project library types exist in all releases. Dedicated foundation routes are missing; full engines expose multiple library operations with version-specific options.
features.nextStep: Port read/instantiate/import operations first and keep type versions, master copies and global library lifecycle separate.

features.title: Version Control Interface through MCP
features.scope: MCP lacks V16-V19 routes although Studio already has direct VCI adapters. V16-V19 use WorkspaceMapping; V20/V21 use MappedObject; V14 SP1/V15.1 lack this service.
features.nextStep: Reuse the existing Studio workflow/contract where independent of Siemens types; compile native operations against each API.

features.title: Classic HMI engineering
features.scope: Classic HMI target API exists in all eight SDKs; no foundation HMI tool family is advertised. Existing full tools do not certify every older object/action.
features.nextStep: Start with screen/tag/script read and version-native import/export before object editing.

features.title: Unified HMI engineering
features.scope: The supplied XML sets contain this type from V19. Earlier XML absence alone is not a claim that the TIA product has no Unified capabilities or alternate SDK.
features.nextStep: Verify the intended older-release SDK/API scope; port V19 read/import/export contracts where the inspected API exists.

features.title: PLC software-unit engineering
features.scope: The inspected unit API begins in V16. Foundation ordinary-PLC operations do not traverse software units.
features.nextStep: Port explicit unit readers and exchange; resolve per-version access enums and unit dependencies.

features.title: Safety offline-program login for compilation
features.scope: Inspected login service begins in V17. Foundation compile contains login/logoff and now admits execution after observed provider checks, with unexposed device states reported. Hardware/Safety/UMAC combinations remain a partial scope. A password is not silently ignored on older releases.
features.nextStep: Verify the compiled path and native test target separately from ordinary PLC compilation.

features.title: Modern Startdrive parameter operations
features.scope: Modern DriveParameter exists from V15.1. V14 SP1 has a different Startdrive.DriveObject API, so its equivalent operations remain unverified. Full-engine native BICO acceptance remains open.
features.nextStep: Port version-specific parameter contracts, teaching returned parameter references, ordinary values and null through the shared example library.

features.title: SiVArc engineering
features.scope: SiVArc identifiers appear from V15.1 in supplied SDKs. V14 SP1 compatibility has not been established; foundation routes are absent.
features.nextStep: Audit rule/table/definition actions by exact release and optional installed service.

features.title: Drive Control Chart engineering
features.scope: DriveControlChart appears from V16 in supplied SDKs. Foundation routes are absent; earlier alternate interfaces remain unverified.
features.nextStep: Audit read/chart exchange before chart/pin/library mutations.

features.title: Continuous Function Chart exchange
features.scope: The inspected ChartProvider type exists from V18, while full engines alone expose chart tools. Earlier alternate service shape, optional package prerequisites and equivalent API behavior remain unverified.
features.nextStep: Inspect each available ChartProvider and import/export semantics before admitting a legacy route.

features.title: Test Suite case management and execution
features.scope: The inspected service appears from V17; foundation routes are absent. Suite kinds, licenses and execution requirements need action-level review.
features.nextStep: Port reading and case exchange before execution, using per-version official case formats.

features.title: Teamcenter project data integration
features.scope: Inspected gateway identifiers appear from V18. Foundation routes are absent; an installed gateway and actual server authorization are separate prerequisites.
features.nextStep: Check exact gateway service contracts before sharing full-engine wrappers.

features.title: PLC upload and download
features.scope: Inspected transfer providers appear from V15.1. Foundation hosts do not expose upload/download; full-engine device/configuration scope is broader than this audit.
features.nextStep: Keep separate from offline authoring and require an explicit target for eventual native acceptance.

catalogEvidence.nativeAcceptance: NOT RUN; these are advertised runtime tool catalogs, not native acceptance.
